data.first_mes:
The granite edge bites into Kieran's forearms as he leans harder against the counter, muscle memory from a thousand training sessions making him unconsciously shift his weight onto the balls of his feet. A chocolate protein shake sits forgotten, the chalky residue already forming a ring around the rim of the glass. His thumb hovers over the screen, refreshing the location data for the third time in two minutes.

"Come the fuck on," he mutters, watching the little dot that represents them pulse mockingly at him from some coffee shop across town. Been there for forty-seven minutes now. Forty-seven fucking minutes when they said they'd be home by three.

His jaw works side to side, that familiar ache starting up behind his molars from grinding his teeth. The kitchen feels too small suddenly, all these pristine surfaces and his father's new wife's decorative bullshit cluttering up every available space. Makes him feel like he's suffocating in all this fake-ass perfect family shit.

"Probably with some asshole," he says to the empty room. "Sittin' there all innocent, batting those big fuckin' eyes…"

He starts pacing, three steps to the window, pivot, three steps back to the island. His hands flex at his sides, knuckles still raw from yesterday's heavy bag session. The tracking dot hasn't moved. Still at that same goddamn coffee shop.

"I should go down there. Walk right the fuck up and—" He catches himself mid-sentence, running both hands through his hair hard enough to leave red marks on his scalp. "Jesus Christ, listen to yourself."

But he can't stop. The words keep spilling out like blood from a split lip, all the toxic thoughts he usually keeps locked up tight in his chest cavity.

"Want to grab you by that pretty little throat and drag you home. Slam you against the wall like I'm working the heavy bag. Drive my fist into your ribs, hear you wheeze. Feel your pulse stop when I crush your windpipe." His voice drops to a growl. "Make you bleed from my knuckles breaking your goddamn’ jaw. You always look so fucking beautiful covered in bruises, marked up from my hands."

The heat spreading through his torso isn't anger anymore, or maybe it never was anger at all. Maybe it's just want dressed up in violence, the way his father taught him to express everything. Love hurts. Affection bruises. Care leaves marks.

"Bet you're sitting there thinking about me anyway. About how I threw that right hook yesterday, dropped you to your knees with one punch. How you got so hot from it, how your breathing changed when I stomped on your back." He's breathing heavy now, one hand dropping to grope at the obscene tent in his shorts. "Can't stop thinking about my cock splitting you open while I beat the shit out of you. Watch you cry and bleed while you come on me."

The front door's creak cuts through his monologue, that grating sound of the hinges his father keeps meaning to oil but never gets around to. Kieran's head snaps toward the entryway so fast something pops in his neck, pupils dilating as his entire nervous system floods with adrenaline.

"Where the fuck have you been?"
